text:
ashok: FYI — GlobePay wants to run a cross-border payments POC next month. Primary asks: SSO (SAML), SCIM sync for ~8k identities, RBAC roles per region, domain ownership proofing, and a pricing ballpark for a 6-week POC.

kelsey: 👍 can you paste their legal/security questionnaire. also do they require data residency (EU/US)?

ashok: Quick notes from the call: EU users must stay in EU region, legal asked for SOC2 + KMS integration. Questionnaire PDF uploaded to drive: https://drive.redwood/globepay/sec-q.pdf 

amy-se: I can own the POC engineering side. Need their SAML metadata and one test-idp. Do we want hosted or dedicated for the run? If EU-only and high throughput SCIM, dedicated might be simpler to guarantee throughput for sync jobs.

dave-infra: For 8k users SCIM delta sync shouldn't be heavy, but if they plan bulk imports or frequent full syncs we should set a rate limit and a backoff. Dedicated reserve option: monthly commit (we can short-term loan a small pool for 6 weeks) — I'll check capacity.

eva-security: Security checklist items: KMS/HSM for key storage, audit log retention >=1yr, SAML assertion encryption optional, AAD/Okta compatibility, SCIM over TLS with client certs if they want mutual TLS. Also need domain verification method — prefer DNS TXT for automation.

ashok: They asked: can Redwood support multiple SAML audiences per tenant? also they need claim mapping (email, sub, groups -> roles).

amy-se: Yes; per-tenant metadata with audience URIs supported. Claim mapping example I sent them in the call:

amy-se: ```
Assertion -> Attributes:
  NameID: urn:globepay:userid
  email: user.email
  groups: membership
  custom: region=eu-west
```

amy-se: For RBAC we suggest mapping groups -> Redwood roles and create role templates per region. We'll provide a sample scripts/notebook to translate SCIM groups -> role assignments.

kelsey: Pricing ask: they want a POC quote for 6 weeks, ~8k users, SSO+SCIM, and optional Dedicated test pool. Any quick numbers?

dave-infra: Quick back-of-envelope: hosted token pricing negligible for auth calls, SCIM sync load priced per sync-job+rate. Dedicated 6-week temporary pool — we can do a short-term committed capacity at ~30% discount of monthly list; I need product to confirm exact slab.

eva-security: Also flag: legal will want an IP/data flow diagram and evidence of KMS integration. Amy — can you produce the dataflow and a sample KMS integration note?

amy-se: Yep. I'll draft a 1-page dataflow and include KMS options (Cloud KMS, customer-managed key in GCP/AWS, HSM note).

ashok: Blockers from call: 1) proof of domain ownership for subdomains across regions 2) SCIM provisioning SLA questions 3) audit/export for SCIM events 4) pricing for Dedicated fallback.

amy-se: For domain proofing we'll ask them to add a DNS TXT record per tenant or upload signed certificate. We also support verification via email to hostmaster@domain if DNS isn't possible, but DNS recommended for automation.

dave-infra: For SCIM events we can stream provisioning logs to their S3/GCS bucket or push webhooks. Will include example payload.

eva-security: About KMS: we require a customer-managed key for Private deployments; hosted can use Redwood-managed KMS but customer will want to ACL the key. Note that HSM-backed keys add a compliance checkbox.

kelsey: Action items: @amy-se draft POC runbook (SAML metadata template, SCIM mapping, RBAC templates, test data), @dave-infra check 6-week dedicated pricing slab & capacity, @eva-security draft answers to security questionnaire sections 3–7. I'll assemble the quote once those are in.

amy-se: I'll push a runbook draft by EOD tomorrow. Sample SCIM mapping + small script included.

dave-infra: I'll confirm capacity + preliminary pricing by EOD Friday.

eva-security: I'll populate the questionnaire with recommended controls and export logs example by tomorrow.

deploy-bot: Incident note: no infra constraints currently for eu-west GPU pool. Allocation request required for temporary dedicated capacity.

ashok: Thanks all — I'll follow up with GlobePay and get their SAML metadata + security contact. Please tag me if you need example assertion samples to test.

kelsey: great — if we can get the runbook + price table this week we should be able to lock POC start date for first week of next month. :thumbsup:
